program_solutions:
(rule!
  (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)])
            ([obj (in-list (filter filled? (objects g 0)))])
    (for*/fold ([acc out])
               ([r (in-range (obj-r1 obj) (+ (obj-r2 obj) 1))]
                [c (in-range (obj-c1 obj) (+ (obj-c2 obj) 1))])
      (if (= (modulo (+ (- r (obj-r1 obj)) (- c (obj-c1 obj))) 2) 0)
          (set-cell acc r c (obj-color obj))
          acc))))
